topics.title: Backend Development & Layered Architecture
topics.concept: Separation of concerns across controllers/views, domain & authorization services, and data persistence.
topics.whereUsed: SystemRPG (ZERO RPG) and Fleet Management & Telemetry.
topics.problemSolved: Prevents tight coupling between web/JavaFX views and SQL queries, making changes testable and maintainable.
topics.decision: Centralize ownership checks in AutorizacaoService (SystemRPG), parameterize JDBC queries, and load all credentials via environment variables.
topics.learning: Standardizing multi-stage Maven/Docker builds and incremental DTO decoupling verified by H2 test suites.

topics.title: Application Security & CI/CD Testing
topics.concept: Authentication/authorization hardening, anti-IDOR/CSRF protection, authenticated encryption, and continuous test verification.
topics.whereUsed: SystemRPG (18/18 JUnit 5 + MockMvc tests), Academic Bot (12/12 HTTP tests + AES-256-GCM), and BIA4vs (secret scanner + unittest).
topics.problemSolved: Prevents unauthorized cross-user access, accidental credential leaks to external LLM providers, and silent regressions.
topics.decision: Enforce Spring Security (BCrypt/CSRF/anti-IDOR) in SystemRPG, BCrypt + rate limiting (429) + TTL + restricted CORS in Academic Bot, and outbound secret scanning in BIA4vs.
topics.learning: Turning security findings into regression tests executed automatically on every push in GitHub Actions.

topics.title: Asynchronous Processing & AI Integration
topics.concept: Background workers, external protocol integration, and decoupled LLM clients with offline fallback.
topics.whereUsed: Academic Bot (Java, Discord JDA, Javalin, IMAP) and BIA4vs (Python, PyQt5, QThread, AIEngineClient / Ollama).
topics.problemSolved: Scheduled IMAP email polling, Discord reminders, and code/PDF analysis without freezing desktop UIs.
topics.decision: Decouple AIEngineClient from PyQt5 with strict local-only mode (BIA4VS_LOCAL_ONLY), configurable timeouts, and safe cancellation.
topics.learning: Handling external failures (HTTP 429/500, timeouts, DNS) via automated failure-mode tests and offline static diagnostics.

topics.title: Algorithms, Data Structures & Study Scheduling
topics.concept: Practical use of priority queues, sorting, search, and dynamic programming for scheduling problems.
topics.whereUsed: Academic Bot (PriorityQueue-based OptimizerService) and the interactive Algorithm Lab.
topics.problemSolved: Allocating weekly 50-minute study blocks weighted by subject difficulty, weight, and upcoming exam urgency.
topics.decision: Combine subject priority and event urgency into a PriorityQueue to deterministically assign available weekday slots.
topics.learning: Comparing greedy heuristics (PriorityQueue) against exact optimization (0/1 Knapsack) depending on problem constraints.
